name: Fairmont Hanoi
short_description: A 5-star luxury Fairmont in Hanoi's historic Old Quarter with 241 rooms and suites, eight dining venues, a spa and bathhouse, and a rooftop pool, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (516 reviews).
ai_summary: Fairmont Hanoi is a 5-star luxury hotel in Hanoi's historic Old Quarter, near Hoan Kiem Lake, with 241 rooms and suites. It has eight dining and bar venues, a wellness floor with a spa and bathhouse, a rooftop pool and terrace, and three signature ballrooms for events. The hotel holds a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 516 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
